# Input

`LhInput` is a form input component based on the native input element, supporting text input, password, character count, and more.

## sx Quick Layout

Use the `sx` prop to quickly set spacing and sizing, without writing extra CSS.

<DemoBlock title="sx spacing">
  <LhInput placeholder="Vertical margin 1, horizontal padding 2" :sx="{ my: 1, px: 2 }" />
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">
import { LhInput } from '@lh-ui/vue3'
</script>

<template>
  <LhInput placeholder="Vertical margin 1, horizontal padding 2" :sx="{ my: 1, px: 2 }" />
</template>
```

```vue options
<script>
import { LhInput } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

export default {
  components: { LhInput },
}
</script>

<template>
  <LhInput placeholder="Vertical margin 1, horizontal padding 2" :sx="{ my: 1, px: 2 }" />
</template>
```

> `sx` is scaled on an `8px` base: `my: 1` → `marginTop/marginBottom: 8px`, `px: 2` → `paddingLeft/Right: 16px`. See [sx Quick Layout](/en/guide/theme-customization#sx-quick-layout) for the full API.

## Prefix & Suffix Icons

`prefix-icon` / `suffix-icon` set the prefix/suffix icons, taking a built-in `LhIcon` name such as `search` or `date`.

## Native Attributes & Autosize

Native attributes such as `autocomplete`, `native-type`, `autofocus` and `minlength` are passed through to the inner input; `autosize` makes a textarea adapt its height to the content.

<DemoBlock title="Native Attributes & Autosize">
  <div class="demo-row">
    <LhInput v-model="enInputNative" autocomplete="off" native-type="text" :minlength="3" placeholder="autocomplete off" style="width: 100%; max-width: 260px" />
    <LhInput v-model="enInputFocus" autofocus placeholder="Autofocus" style="width: 100%; max-width: 260px" />
  </div>
  <div class="demo-row">
    <LhInput v-model="enInputAutosize" type="textarea" :autosize="{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 4 }" placeholder="Autosize" style="width: 100%; max-width: 300px" />
  </div>
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">

  <LhInput v-model="value" autofocus placeholder="Autofocus" />
  <LhInput v-model="value" type="textarea" :autosize="{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 4 }" placeholder="Autosize" />
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
|------|-------------|------|---------|
| modelValue | Bound value | `string` | — |
| type | Input type | `"number" \| "text" \| "textarea" \| "password" \| "email" \| "url" \| "tel" \| "date" \| "time"` | `'text'` |
| size | — | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large" \| "mini" \| "x-large"` | `'medium'` |
| disabled | Disabled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| readonly | — | `boolean` | `false` |
| placeholder | Placeholder text | `string` | — |
| maxlength | Maximum length | `number` | — |
| minlength | — | `number` | — |
| showWordLimit | Show character count | `boolean` | `false` |
| clearable | Show clear button | `boolean` | `false` |
| prefixIcon | Prefix icon name (a built-in LhIcon name) | `LhIconName` | — |
| suffixIcon | Suffix icon name (a built-in LhIcon name) | `LhIconName` | — |
| autofocus | — | `boolean` | `false` |
| autocomplete | — | `string` | — |
| nativeType | — | `string` | — |
| autosize | — | `boolean \| { minRows?: number; maxRows?: number; }` | `false` |
| resize | — | `"none" \| "both" \| "horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `'vertical'` |
| name | — | `string` | — |
| rows | — | `number` | — |
| tabindex | — | `string \| number` | — |
| form | — | `string` | — |
| inputStyle | — | `{ [x: string]: string; }` | — |
| label | — | `string` | — |
| themeVars | Component-level theme variables, overrides ConfigProvider | `{ [x: string]: string; }` | — |
| bgPattern | Component-level background pattern, overrides ConfigProvider | `string` | — |
| sx | sx quick-layout props | `SxProps` | — |

## Events

| Event | Description | Callback |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| update:modelValue | Value change | `(value: string) => void` |
| change | Input change | `(value: string) => void` |
| input | Input event | `(value: string) => void` |
| focus | Focus event | `(e: FocusEvent) => void` |
| blur | Blur event | `(e: FocusEvent) => void` |
| clear | Clear clicked | `() => void` |
| keydown | Native keydown event | `(e: KeyboardEvent) => void` |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
|------|-------------|
| prefix | Prefix content |
| suffix | Suffix content |
